name: neon-arcade
description: NEON ARCADE — monorepo (backend API, public frontend, admin panel)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix admin run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix admin run typecheck
